## Release Notes

- Use now merged TokTok master version of netlify workflow. @iphydf (#79)
- Move to TokTok version of the netlify workflow. @iphydf (#76)
- Pass auth token to netlify workflow. @iphydf (#75)
- Add the 2 other default workflows. @iphydf (#55)
- Point at the merged toktok release drafter. @iphydf (#54)
- Remove comments. @iphydf (#53)
- Rename draft to release. @iphydf (#52)
- Remove release-drafter.yml. @iphydf (#51)
- Try release drafter action. @iphydf (#50)

## Features

- Add another sentence to the hello world. @iphydf (#78)
- Make a comment both at the start and at the end of build. @iphydf (#68)
- Build netlify previews on github actions. @iphydf (#62)

## Bug Fixes

- Secrets correct. @iphydf (#77)
- Use Docker for security in building the web deploy. @iphydf (#69)
- Even better note format. @iphydf (#67)
- Grep out the correct URL from preview deploys. @iphydf (#66)
- Use correct note format in comment. @iphydf (#65)
- Netlify build script needs to be executable. @iphydf (#63)

## Maintenance (Grunt tasks)

- Release v0.1.1 @iphydf (#81)
- Add changelog for release. @iphydf (#80)
- Use the TokTok version of netlify workflow. @iphydf (#73)
- Use common workflow for netlify build. @iphydf (#72)
- Use master build script but PR data. @iphydf (#64)
- Fix pages permissions. @iphydf (#61)
- Add GitHub pages workflow. @iphydf (#60)
- Add more descriptive/precise tags to bazel build rules. @iphydf (#59)
- Check if restyled uploads the patch. @iphydf (#56)

## Maintenance (Code cleanup)

- Use green tip for success. @iphydf (#70)
- Delete old qt test code. @iphydf (#57)

## Maintenance (Tests)

- Ensure that we don't have access to github token in docker. @iphydf (#71)
